arg.name: config_file
arg.description: bridge_config.yaml (CARLA, blueprint and map aliases, Traffic Manager, agent relay)

arg.name: carla_host
arg.description: CARLA host; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: carla_port
arg.description: CARLA RPC port; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: ssv2_port
arg.description: ZMQ port SSv2 connects to; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: agent_relay
arg.description: tcp://host:port of the agent relay that drives entities with controller `agent`; empty keeps the config file's (default tcp://localhost:5560)

arg.name: weather
arg.description: CARLA weather preset (ClearNoon, CloudySunset, HardRainNight, ...) applied on connect and after every map load; empty keeps the config file's (default: leave CARLA's). Change at run time with /carla/set_weather
